lines.t: The road was rough
But the truth cut through
Like a fire in the dark
Making all things new
I walk crooked lines
With a stubborn heart
Until the word came down
And tore my world apart
Now I hear that car rolling
Like a thunder sound
Telling me to stand
When the whole world bows down
Break me wide open
Make me right
Turn these ashes into light
When the lies come blowing through
I keep my eyes on what is true
Take these chains and make them gone
Lead me where I belong
I was lost but now I'm found
By the hand that turns it all around
Every voice tried pulling me away
But mercy met me in the middle of the grave
What was scattered now is coming clear
Truth keeps speaking loud enough to hear
And I won't run from the fire anymore
I was made for the fight and I know what it's for
Break me wide open, make me right
Turn these ashes into light
When the lies come blowing through
I keep my eyes on what is true
Take these chains and make them gone
Lead me where I belong
I was lost but now I'm found
By the hand that turns it all around
Set these crooked paths straight
Let the dead thing live today
Every broken piece of me
Is a place your power can reach
Break me wide open, make me right
Turn these ashes into light
When the lights come blowing through
I keep my eyes on what is true
Take these chains and make them go
Lead me where I belong
I was lost but now I'm found
By the hand that turned it all around
Thank you.
